'''Peter Frafjord''' (also '''Pete Frafjord'''; also published as '''Peter Fratjord''') is a [[Star Wars CCG]] player who played the [[2008 World Championship]] and, in 2009, the [[2009 Bespin Regionals]] and [[2009 US West Nationals]].<ref name="w08d2">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/tournaments/Decklists/2008/Worlds/2008+Worlds+D2.pdf 2008 Worlds Day 2.pdf], res.starwarsccg.org (sheet signed "Peter Frafjord"). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008202350/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/tournaments/Decklists/2008/Worlds/2008+Worlds+D2.pdf Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="wn09d1">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/tournaments/Decklists/2009/West+National/2009+West+Nationals+Day+1.pdf 2009 West Nationals Day 1.pdf], res.starwarsccg.org (sheet signed "Pete Frafjord").</ref> The wiki first published his decks as "Peter Fratjord", a misreading of the handwritten f.
